snippets.title: Six bi-monthly rounds over time — the gap holds
snippets.sentence: Read left to right as a six-round bi-monthly timeline, the program's self-reported service-delivery stays above what the independent survey confirms at each round while the control arm stays low — the gap holds across time, not in a single snapshot.

snippets.title: Where delivery happened vs where the survey checked (the map moves)
snippets.sentence: Program delivery is concentrated inside the intervention ward and absent in the adjacent control ward, while the independent survey covered both — so the coverage gap tracks where the program went, not where the survey looked; a docked Layers panel turns the designed sampling plan and its real building footprints on over the survey, and stepping the cycle selector flies the map to the next real ward pair.

snippets.title: The per-surveyor quality scorecard catches a surveyor
snippets.sentence: The survey's quality is not asserted in aggregate — it is computed per surveyor from each surveyor's own records, so a single under-performing surveyor is visible and accountable rather than averaged away. GPS is clean for everyone — the app gates submission at 15 m — so the flag rests on the signals that gating can't launder — evidence, on-primary fidelity, and back-check agreement.

snippets.title: GPS is clean — the Distributions screen catches the fabrication
snippets.sentence: A fabricator who never leaves the 15 m gate passes GPS, but cannot fake the SHAPE of their data — the Distributions screen scores each surveyor against their peers on interview speed and answer-uniformity with no second visit, and the flagged surveyor reads red on both while everyone else sits normal.

snippets.title: The independent back-check confirms it
snippets.sentence: An independent re-survey by a different enumerator disagrees with this surveyor's originals on identity, location, and outcome — the strongest evidence their data needs review — and the method is traceable to its source.
